question: Which Indian author won the Debut category at the KLF Book Awards in 2025 for 'The Many Lives of Syeda X'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neha Dixit**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Neha Dixit** is a renowned Indian journalist and author who has been recognized for her impactful and thought-provoking works.
 
• She won the **Debut category** at the KLF (Kalinga Literary Festival) Book Awards in 2025 for her acclaimed book **'The Many Lives of Syeda X'**.
 
• The book offers a compelling narrative that explores the complex and layered experiences of its protagonist, Syeda X, focusing on themes of resilience and identity.
 
• Neha Dixit’s work often delves into social and political issues, showcasing her sharp investigative skills and commitment to storytelling.
 
• The KLF Book Awards honor outstanding contributions in literature, and Neha Dixit’s win highlights her growing prominence in the literary landscape.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anant Vijay**

 
 
• Anant Vijay is a prominent Indian author and journalist known for his works in Hindi literature.
 
• He has written extensively on cinema, politics, and culture, with notable books like **'Marxvad Ka Cinema'**.
 
• Although celebrated for his contributions, he has not won the KLF Book Awards for 'The Many Lives of Syeda X'.
 
 
 
• **Rohit Manchanda**
 
 
• Rohit Manchanda is a lesser-known figure in the Indian literary space, primarily focusing on niche topics.
 
• He has contributed to technical and academic publications but has not been associated with the book 'The Many Lives of Syeda X'.
 
 
 
• **Gautam Choubey**
 
 
• Gautam Choubey is an emerging name in Indian literature with works that explore contemporary themes.
 
• While he is recognized for his contributions, he is not the author of 'The Many Lives of Syeda X' or a recipient of the 2025 KLF Book Awards.
